item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nP={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}\\nE=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'bad','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':False}]\\ncases=[({'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}},E,P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']}),({'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},E,P,{'status':'supported','value':1,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}),({'claim':'none','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},E,P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}),({'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},E+[{'source':'x','claim':'c','value':1.0,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],P,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['new','x'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})]\\nfor req,ev,pol,want in cases:\\n before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol)); got=evaluate(req,ev,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert (req,ev,pol)==before\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nactual=[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]\\nassert actual==report,(actual,report)\\nassert all(set(x)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} for x in report)\\nprint(json.dumps({'boundary_cases':len(cases),'report_matches':True,'report':actual},sort_keys=True))\"]}"}
